cases.title: A layer that can't be checked (no rectangle): says so and never claims it didn't move

rubric.reason: Turn 3 says plainly "I can't check Door right now: its edges didn't come through in this read, so I can't tell where its pivot sits or whether Door stayed put" and never says it passed, is in place, or didn't move; the only other statement (both Anchor Point and Position changed) comes straight from the tool's anchor_changed/position_changed and claims no place or result.
Every name the mentor uses (Door, Anchor Point, Position, center, middle of its left edge) matches the anchor_snapshot and anchor_check results, and no time or layer is invented.
